title: Communist Party of China
capsule: Through the 1930s the Chinese Communist Party's Jiangxi Soviet endured repeated Nationalist encirclement campaigns before the 1934-35 Long March relocated its surviving forces to a new base at Yan'an in Shaanxi. Allied uneasily with the Kuomintang against Japan during the Second United Front (1937-1945), the party expanded its territory and membership, then defeated the Nationalists in the 1945-1949 civil war, proclaiming the People's Republic of China in Beijing on 1 October 1949 under Mao Zedong's chairmanship.
attestation: Boundaries from Seshat Cliopatria (Bennett et al., Scientific Data 2025; CC BY 4.0), digitized from standard historical atlases at ~0.07° resolution. The CCP's controlled territory during 1932–1949 is incompletely mapped; borders of the Jiangxi Soviet and Yan'an base area are approximated from historical accounts rather than administrative surveys, and front lines shifted rapidly throughout the Civil War period. Capsule researched for this polity/era specifically (confidence: high).
